items.title: Bobby Militello interviewed by Monk Rowe, Buffalo, New York, October 14, 2002
items.q: when I go to do the audition they were preparing for a gig they had to do in New York and who is there is Joe Morello and Eugene Wright.

ctx.x: I says, “Yeah, with Maynard Ferguson?” All of a sudden I’m realizing there’s some truth in who this is on the phone. And he says, “Well you played that flute solo,” he says, “well my wife was out in the crowd and she heard you and came back to get me.” I came out and only heard the last 30 seconds, maybe minute of your solo, but twenty thousand people stood up and cheered when you finished. And he said, “That sort of said something. But my wife said you were a phenomenal player. So we wrote your name down in the…
